item.title: Privacy Policy - Molitor Construction LLC
item.dc:creator: portagehomebuilder
item.content:encoded:
Molitor Construction LLC - Privacy Policy

Privacy Policy

Molitor Construction LLC is committed to protecting your privacy. This privacy policy outlines the information we collect, how we use it, and how we safeguard your personal data.

Information We Collect

We collect personal information such as your name, email address, phone number, and project details when you contact us through our website or request a quote. We may also collect non-personal information, such as your IP address, browser type, and referring URL, to improve our website functionality and services.

How We Use Your Information

We use the information you provide to respond to inquiries, offer quotes, schedule services, and improve our customer experience. We may also use your contact information to send updates about your project or promotions related to our services.

How We Protect Your Information

We take reasonable steps to protect your personal information from unauthorized access, use, or disclosure. Our website is secured with encryption protocols to ensure your data is transmitted securely.

Sharing Your Information

We will never sell, rent, or share your personal information with third parties, except when required by law or to fulfill your service request (e.g., subcontractors or suppliers involved in your project).

Your Choices

You can opt out of receiving promotional emails or updates from us at any time by clicking the unsubscribe link in our emails or contacting us directly.

Changes to This Policy

We reserve the right to update or modify this privacy policy at any time. Any changes will be posted on this page with the updated date.

item.title: Farmhouse Addition Project Underway in Rio, Wisconsin
item.dc:creator: portagehomebuilder
item.content:encoded:
[et_pb_section fb_built="1" theme_builder_area="post_content" _builder_version="4.27.6" _module_preset="default"][et_pb_row _builder_version="4.27.6" _module_preset="default" theme_builder_area="post_content"][et_pb_column _builder_version="4.27.6" _module_preset="default" type="4_4" theme_builder_area="post_content"][et_pb_text _builder_version="4.27.6" _module_preset="default" theme_builder_area="post_content" hover_enabled="0" sticky_enabled="0"]

We're excited to share the start of another construction project in Rio, Wisconsin! Our team has recently begun framing a new addition onto an older farmhouse, and we're proud to be serving as the general contractor for this unique build.

Adding modern living space to a historic home requires careful planning and craftsmanship. Our goal is to blend the new construction seamlessly with the character and charm of the existing farmhouse while providing the homeowners with the additional space they need. The framing phase is now underway, and it's always exciting to see the project begin to take shape.

As construction progresses, we'll be sharing more updates and photos from the job site. Be sure to check back often and follow along as we transform this beautiful farmhouse with a custom addition designed to serve the family for years to come. We look forward to showing you the finished result!

[/et_pb_text][/et_pb_column][/et_pb_row][/et_pb_section]

item.title: Custom Deck Project Taking Shape in Sun Prairie, Wisconsin
item.dc:creator: portagehomebuilder
item.content:encoded:
[et_pb_section fb_built="1" theme_builder_area="post_content" _builder_version="4.27.6" _module_preset="default"][et_pb_row _builder_version="4.27.6" _module_preset="default" theme_builder_area="post_content"][et_pb_column _builder_version="4.27.6" _module_preset="default" type="4_4" theme_builder_area="post_content"][et_pb_text _builder_version="4.27.6" _module_preset="default" theme_builder_area="post_content" hover_enabled="0" sticky_enabled="0"]

It's been a busy spring and summer season, and we're excited to showcase one of our recent deck projects in Sun Prairie, Wisconsin. Our crew recently completed the framing and construction of two custom decks for a beautiful parade home being built by Capstone Builders.

This project includes a large covered deck designed to provide comfortable outdoor living space in any weather, along with a smaller grilling deck that offers convenient access from the home to the backyard. The grilling deck also features stairs leading down to the yard, creating a seamless transition between indoor and outdoor living areas.

Custom decks are one of the best ways to extend your living space and increase the enjoyment of your home. Whether it's entertaining guests, enjoying family gatherings, or simply relaxing outdoors, a well-designed deck can add both beauty and functionality to any property.

We'll continue sharing updates and photos from our deck projects throughout the season, so be sure to check back often to see what our team has been building across the area.

[/et_pb_text][/et_pb_column][/et_pb_row][/et_pb_section]

item.title: Custom Pool Deck Project in Pardeeville Featuring Modern Lighting and Cable Railings
item.dc:creator: portagehomebuilder
item.content:encoded:
[et_pb_section fb_built="1" _builder_version="4.27.6" _module_preset="default" global_colors_info="{}"][et_pb_row _builder_version="4.27.6" _module_preset="default" global_colors_info="{}"][et_pb_column type="4_4" _builder_version="4.27.6" _module_preset="default" global_colors_info="{}"][et_pb_text _builder_version="4.27.6" _module_preset="default" global_colors_info="{}"]

We're excited to showcase another recent outdoor living project in Pardeeville, Wisconsin. This large custom pool deck was designed to create the perfect space for relaxing, entertaining, and enjoying the backyard throughout the summer season.

One of the standout features of this project is the sleek cable railing system, which provides safety without obstructing views of the pool and surrounding landscape. The deck also includes low-voltage stair riser lighting and illuminated post caps, adding both beauty and functionality. These lighting features enhance visibility after dark while creating a warm, inviting atmosphere for evening gatherings.

Projects like this demonstrate how thoughtful design elements can transform a backyard into a true outdoor living destination. The combination of modern railings, custom lighting, and quality craftsmanship creates a deck that is both practical and visually impressive.

We'll be sharing additional photos, a full walk-through, and video footage of this project soon, so be sure to check back for a closer look at all the details that make this Pardeeville pool deck one of our favorite builds of the season.

item.title: Composite Deck Replacement Project for Condo Owners
item.dc:creator: portagehomebuilder
item.content:encoded:
[et_pb_section fb_built="1" _builder_version="4.27.6" _module_preset="default" global_colors_info="{}"][et_pb_row _builder_version="4.27.6" _module_preset="default" global_colors_info="{}"][et_pb_column type="4_4" _builder_version="4.27.6" _module_preset="default" global_colors_info="{}"][et_pb_text _builder_version="4.27.6" _module_preset="default" global_colors_info="{}"]

Recently, our team completed a deck renovation project involving two side-by-side condo decks. The existing wood decking had reached the end of its lifespan, so the homeowners decided it was time for an upgrade. We removed the old wood decking and replaced it with durable, low-maintenance composite decking on both decks to create a clean, consistent appearance across the property.

Composite decking has become one of the most popular choices for homeowners because it offers the beauty of wood without the ongoing maintenance. Unlike traditional wood decks, composite materials resist rot, splintering, and weather damage while requiring very little upkeep. By installing matching composite decking on both units, we were able to enhance the overall appearance of the condo and provide the owners with outdoor living spaces they can enjoy for years to come.

Whether you're looking for a complete deck replacement, composite decking installation, or a custom deck builder in Sun Prairie, Portage, Pardeeville, or the surrounding Wisconsin communities, our team is ready to help. We specialize in deck construction, deck renovations, and outdoor living projects designed to add beauty, value, and functionality to your home. Contact us today to learn more about upgrading your existing deck with modern composite materials.
